flow.caption_zh:
那年
北極圈内
海風習習    
吹醒慵懶夏日
色彩透明如遠山積雪
心情曖昧如隔水雲煙

en: As if a song rose like the wind
There is something more tender than the night
It is the tide beating back and forth against the shore
There is something quieter than the distant mountains
It is drifting ice, adrift without intent
Last night fine snow fell softly
This morning, a fine, sparse rain
Light and shadow breaking through the clouds
Glimmering faintly on the distant sea
Only then did I think to ask
How the snowflakes form on their own
Yet was asked about for no reason
Why do the lines of the poem grow distant and lonely?
Where the snowy peak gazes fixedly
There is always mist lingering round
A realm receding into the distance
Clouds and sky stretching on without end
There is a song like the wind

points.zh: Svalbard位於挪威北部，北極圈内的一組群島，Spitsbergen是其中最大的島。該島最北端跨入北緯80度。攝影圖片係Regent Voyage清晨駛進入Longyearbyen 海灣時所照。Longyearbyen是Spitsbergen島上的最大聚落，居民只有二千人，却是全世界最北端的最大聚落，是Svalbard北極圈遊輪的主要出入港灣。
points.en: Svalbard is a group of islands north of Norway, within the Arctic Circle. Spitsbergen is the largest of these islands, its northernmost point crossing into 80 degrees north latitude. This photograph was taken by Regent Voyage as the ship sailed into Longyearbyen bay in the early morning. Longyearbyen is the largest settlement on Spitsbergen, with a population of only two thousand, yet it is the largest settlement at the northernmost point in the world, and serves as the main port of embarkation and disembarkation for Arctic cruises to Svalbard.
